data.narrative:
Lodge Systems is a pre-seed stage company in Defense & Security led by Stuart Lodge. The valuation universe comprises 24 same-sector peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, with top-tier private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method is not applicable. A narrow filter for pre-seed stage Defense & Security companies yielded insufficient datapoints (0 same-stage matches, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier), falling short of the minimum 3-company threshold required for reliable triangulation. A sector-wide median across all 24 Defense & Security peers would introduce significant stage and business model heterogeneity, rendering the result misleading for a pre-seed asset.

Without sufficient same-stage comparables, alternative valuation methods—venture capital method, forward revenue multiples, or stage-appropriate benchmark approaches—would be required to establish a defensible range. The sparse pre-seed coverage within Defense & Security reflects the sector's typical funding concentration at later stages. Further diligence should establish whether adjacent-stage or cross-sector pre-seed data can meaningfully inform valuation, or whether founder track record, technical differentiation, and capital requirements warrant a bespoke framework. A triangulated range cannot be supported with current data.
